Best purchase I ever made for the boys room Keeps everything together very organized and clean. With a lot of space for storage Currently using it as bookshelf and toy storage
This Montessori bookshelf reminds me of daycare setups (in a good way). My wife runs a daycare so we love that style. Seems sturdy and like it’ll last a long time.
Nice set of shelves. Good quality. Easy to put together.

We’re using this wooden bookshelf in our family room and it’s been a great addition. The size is perfect for keeping things organized without taking up too much space, and the open cubbies make everything easy to grab like books, electronics, paperwork, and even a few decor pieces. Assembly was straightforward and the shelves feel solid once put together. It’s sturdy enough to hold heavier items like speakers and books without bowing. I also love how versatile it is because I can style it neatly or use it as functional storage without it looking cluttered.
Commandé pour ma petite-fille de 2 ans, cette étagère est idéale pour ranger les livres avec une bonne hauteur et inclinaison. Je vous la recommande.

I loved this book shelf so much that after I got it I ended up buying a second, one for upstairs and one for downstairs. It is so cute and fits so many books! More than I had expected. Assembly was quick and easy and I was able to put it together myself. It feels stable and even comes with equipment to mount to the wall to keep it from falling or being pulled down. Such a great price point overall, and especially when compared to other similar products which I found to be typically more expensive. 10/10 recommend!

Beautiful bookshelf… it’s straightforward to assemble, it ‹NAMN› be even easier if you are doing it with four hands. We reduced one star because there are three screws that don’t fit in the holes. We had to force tightening them and in the end the wood around the holes split. It doesn’t show in the front but we know about them. P.S. my 2-year-old is reading a lot more since the shelf is built.
We bought it for our daughter and both of our girls love it! They jump and have fun in it every day! Easy assembling and fast delivery!
I’m a mom of a 3 yr old. It was very easy to put together, which is good since my husband works a lot. No springs, 4 screws, and just all around, a good product.

Parents can use this easel together with their children to draw and puzzle, enhancing the parent-child bond, making it a very practical tool for parent-child interaction.
Whether in the living room, study, or beside a desk, this easel fits in well, providing children with a dedicated space for learning and creativity.
This easel is not only suitable for children but also enhances parent-child interaction, allowing them to draw and puzzle together, strengthening the parent-child bond.
The easel's adjustable height design allows it to accompany children as they grow, remaining relevant for many years and offering excellent value for money!
The easel's design is simple and elegant, and the wooden material gives it a very high-end look. It looks beautiful in the living room or study, enhancing the overall home decor.
The easel's double sides are magnetic, allowing children to use magnetic stickers for puzzles or magnetic rings to secure the roll paper, making drawing more convenient.
